# Average annual hours actually worked per worker (fixture)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

Average annual hours actually worked per worker are comparatively low. The indicator
divides total hours worked by total persons in employment, without distinguishing
between full-time and part-time employment. A country with a large part-time sector
will therefore show fewer average hours per worker even when full-time employees work
exactly as long as elsewhere. The published table lists one number per country per year
and is frequently quoted as a statement about how much people work.
